question: Which structure was built as a war memorial to soldiers of the undivided Indian Army during the First World War?

options.text: Lahori Gate in the Red Fort

solution:
The correct answer is **India Gate**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **India Gate** was built as a war memorial to soldiers of the undivided Indian Army who died during the First World War.
 
• It was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens, a prominent British architect.
 
• The structure was completed in 1931 and stands at the eastern end of the Rajpath in New Delhi.
